preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10**6 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in seq) and len(seq) == n for n, seq in zip([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip()]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence contains n distinct integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((sorted_seq[i] == seq[i] or (i > 0 and sorted_seq[i] == seq[i-1]) or (i < n-1 and sorted_seq[i] == seq[i+1])) for i in range(n)) == (line == 'YES') for n, seq, line in zip([int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip()], stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if every element in the input sequence is at most 1 position away from its correct position in the sorted sequence; otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
